title: Summability of binary values
statement: For every sequence $p:\mathbb{N}\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$, the series whose $i$th term is $2^{-(i+1)}$ if $p(i)$ is true and $0$ otherwise is summable.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is a Boolean-valued sequence indexed by the natural numbers
